stories.title: Flintshire residents asked to name unsafe walking and cycling routes
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has opened a 12-week consultation asking people which walking, wheeling and cycling routes should be built or improved across the county. stories.title: Motorcycle recorded at 127mph on A494 in Mold, North Wales Police say
stories.summary: A motorcycle was recorded travelling at 127mph on the A494 in Mold during police patrols at the weekend. North Wales Police Roads Policing Unit said a second motorcycle was recorded at 97mph on the same stretch of road, carrying a pillion passenger. stories.title: Deeside packaging manufacturer recruiting five apprentices
stories.summary: Five apprenticeships have opened at MM Packaging on Deeside Industrial Park, with places in engineering, finance, operations and estimating. The company makes cartonboard packaging for brands in confectionery, drinks, pet food, cereal and frozen food from its site on Parkway.
